assumptions.name: Annual verification and compliance cost
assumptions.why: Upper end of the Rs 15-20 lakh reported per unit. No verifier publishes a fee, and it may include consultants.

assumptions.name: Verified intensity of the current rod
assumptions.why: Median of ten Indian plants in a draft government schedule (2.96), plus 0.1 for rolling. No mill's verified CBAM figure is public.

assumptions.name: Verified intensity of low-carbon rod
assumptions.why: ICRA's 0.7 for scrap EAF plus rolling and charge.

assumptions.name: Low-carbon rod premium
assumptions.why: Midpoint of USD 190-210/t, quoted for green steel generally. Nobody publishes a price for Indian EAF rod.

assumptions.name: Discount rate
assumptions.why: Judgement for an Indian mid-sized exporter.

assumptions.name: First year on verified data
assumptions.why: The Commission expects first verification work in early 2027, and EFDA calls verified data for 2026 imports highly unlikely.
